sections.text:
Ability Power 210. Attacks all enemies four times, dealing magic wind damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill Level.
Increases the physical and magical Ability Power of damage received by all enemies by 30 for 60 seconds.
Reduces the stats of all enemies by 50% for 60 seconds.
Reduces the Unison gauge of all enemies by 20.
Increases the Unison gauge for all allies excluding yourself by 20.
Increases your Unison gauge gains by 3 for 40 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 6500
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 6500
